target.why: region-independent; already exists; no new paid storage would be created

source.why: the verified copy; reading it avoids re-downloading ~20.8 GB

preconditions: owner approval for one short CPU Pod (mounts.global is API-only for CPU pods)
the source volume is mounted read-only in spirit: nothing is deleted or edited
both volumes attach to ONE Pod (one network + one global)

C_transfer.runs_in: one CPU Pod in US-MO-1 with both volumes attached

E_model_loading.requires: one GPU Pod with the global mount; proves or disproves mmap

F_cutover.rule: no production cutover in this task; the regional volume stays the default

rollback: nothing is deleted or moved: the source volume stays untouched
the global volume can be deleted by an explicit owner decision, priced below

old_volume.rule: never deleted or altered without a separate owner decision and a verified backup
